name: caveman
description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Shortens prose while preserving technical terms, code, commands, and exact errors.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/caveman-activate.js"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/caveman-activate.js" --subagent
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/caveman-mode-tracker.js"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/caveman-stats.js" --record
